Gate-activation hypothesis

The gate activates when the model asserts a lack of knowledge or certainty about a specific fact, detail, or outcome. It fires on phrases indicating that information is unknown, unclear, uncertain, or not provided, often in response to user queries where the model cannot verify the answer or the source text lacks the requested data.

Describes when the gate fires. It does not establish the transform’s causal output effect.
